packageRules.description: Database majors are one-way data-dir upgrades: never proposed. Upgrade by hand after a fresh dump (clusters/platform/data/RESTORE.md).
App images (contract section 8): production references vX.Y.Z only. Track release tags, ignore sha- tags, no digest pin. Merging the bump PR is the deploy.

Staging follows releases (INFRA-36): bumps of manifests under a ziftbook-staging/ directory, majors included, merge without a PR once CI passes on the branch. Own branch prefix so a staging bump never shares a branch (and its automerge) with a production bump, which stays a PR.
